purpose: Append-only provenance ledger for observations, contracts, runs, edges, artifacts, input dispositions, and hypothesis decisions
ledger_id_format: ledger:v1:sha256:<canonical record payload digest excluding ledger_id>

pattern_decision_extension.separation_rule: Input disposition describes evidence eligibility; hypothesis lifecycle describes the hypothesis. They must remain separate fields in the same ledger event.

duplicate_policy: same ledger_id and same content is an idempotent no-op; same ledger_id with different content is a hard integrity error
concurrency: writers are serialized by an advisory sidecar lock
